# ui-input

> Single-line text input using contenteditable with form association.

**Class:** `UIInput`

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `value` | `string` | Current text value |
| `placeholder` | `string` | Placeholder text shown when empty |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | Disables interaction |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | Prevents editing while remaining focusable |
| `required` | `boolean` | Marks as required for form validation |
| `name` | `string` | Form field name |

## Events

| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ui-input` | Fired on each keystroke with `{ value }` detail |
| `ui-change` | Fired on blur with `{ value }` detail |

## Slots

| Slot | |
|------|-|
| `leading` | |
| `trailing` | |

## Usage

```html
<ui-input></ui-input>
```
